21 @[builtin_command_elab moduleDoc] def elabModuleDoc : CommandElab := fun stx => do
22   let some range ← Elab.getDeclarationRange? stx
23     | return  -- must be from partial syntax, ignore
24 
25   match stx[1] with
26   | Syntax.atom _ val =>
27     if getMainVersoModuleDocs (← getEnv) |>.isEmpty then
28       let doc := String.Pos.Raw.extract val 0 (val.rawEndPos.unoffsetBy ⟨2⟩)
29       modifyEnv fun env => addMainModuleDoc env ⟨doc, range⟩
30     else
31       throwError m!"Can't add Markdown-format module docs because there is already Verso-format content present."
32   | Syntax.node _ ``Lean.Parser.Command.versoCommentBody args =>
33     let docSyntax := args.getD 0 .missing
34     if docSyntax.getKind == `Lean.Doc.Syntax.parseFailure then
35       -- Report parser errors without attempting elaboration
36       runTermElabM fun _ => reportVersoParseFailure docSyntax
37     else
38       runTermElabM fun _ => do
39         addVersoModDocString range ⟨docSyntax⟩
40   | _ => throwErrorAt stx "unexpected module doc string{indentD <| stx}"

42 private def addScope (isNewNamespace : Bool) (header : String) (newNamespace : Name)
43     (isNoncomputable isPublic isMeta : Bool := false) (attrs : List (TSyntax ``Parser.Term.attrInstance) := []) :
44     CommandElabM Unit := do
45   modify fun s => { s with
46     env    := s.env.registerNamespace newNamespace,
47     scopes := { s.scopes.head! with
48       header := header, currNamespace := newNamespace
49       isNoncomputable := s.scopes.head!.isNoncomputable || isNoncomputable
50       isPublic := s.scopes.head!.isPublic || isPublic
51       isMeta := s.scopes.head!.isMeta || isMeta
52       attrs := s.scopes.head!.attrs ++ attrs
53     } :: s.scopes
54   }
55   pushScope
56   if isNewNamespace then
57     activateScoped newNamespace
58 
59 private def addScopes (header : Name) (isNewNamespace : Bool) (isNoncomputable isPublic isMeta : Bool := false)
60     (attrs : List (TSyntax ``Parser.Term.attrInstance) := []) : CommandElabM Unit :=
61   go header
62 where go
63   | .anonymous => pure ()
64   | .str p header => do
65     go p
66     let currNamespace ← getCurrNamespace
67     addScope isNewNamespace header (if isNewNamespace then Name.mkStr currNamespace header else currNamespace) isNoncomputable isPublic isMeta attrs
68   | _ => throwError "invalid scope"
69 
70 private def addNamespace (header : Name) : CommandElabM Unit :=
71   addScopes (isNewNamespace := true) (isNoncomputable := false) (attrs := []) header
72 
73 def withNamespace {α} (ns : Name) (elabFn : CommandElabM α) : CommandElabM α := do
74   addNamespace ns
75   let a ← elabFn
76   modify fun s => { s with scopes := s.scopes.drop ns.getNumParts }
77   pure a
78 
79 private def popScopes (numScopes : Nat) : CommandElabM Unit :=
80   for _ in *...numScopes do
81     popScope
82 
83 private def innermostScopeName? : List Scope → Option Name
84   | { header := "", .. } :: _ => none
85   | { header := h, .. }  :: _ => some <| .mkSimple h
86   | _                         => some .anonymous -- should not happen
87 
88 private def checkEndHeader : Name → List Scope → Option Name
89   | .anonymous, _ => none
90   | .str p s, { header := h, .. } :: scopes =>
91     if h == s then
92       (.str · s) <$> checkEndHeader p scopes
93     else
94       some <| .mkSimple h
95   | _, _ => some .anonymous -- should not happen

102 @[builtin_command_elab «section»] def elabSection : CommandElab := fun stx => do
103   match stx with
104   | `(Parser.Command.section| $[@[expose%$expTk]]? $[public%$publicTk]? $[noncomputable%$ncTk]? $[meta%$metaTk]? section $(header?)?) =>
105     -- TODO: allow more attributes?
106     let attrs ← if expTk.isSome then
107       pure [← `(Parser.Term.attrInstance| expose)]
108     else
109       pure []
110     if let some header := header? then
111       addScopes (isNewNamespace := false) (isNoncomputable := ncTk.isSome) (isPublic := publicTk.isSome) (isMeta := metaTk.isSome) (attrs := attrs) header.getId
112     else
113       addScope (isNewNamespace := false) (isNoncomputable := ncTk.isSome) (isPublic := publicTk.isSome) (isMeta := metaTk.isSome) (attrs := attrs) "" (← getCurrNamespace)
114   | _                        => throwUnsupportedSyntax

119 /--
120 Produces a `Name` composed of the names of at most the innermost `n` scopes in `ss`, truncating if an
121 empty scope is reached (so that we do not suggest names like `Foo.«».Bar`).
122 
123 If `n` is not specified, will use all scopes in `ss`.
124 -/
125 private def nameOfScopes : (ss : List Scope) → (n : Nat := ss.length) → Name
126   | _, 0 => .anonymous
127   | [], _ => .anonymous
128   | s :: ss, n + 1 =>
129     if s.header == "" then
130       .anonymous
131     else
132     .str (nameOfScopes ss n) s.header
133 
134 /--
135 Returns the first suffix of `base` that begins with `seg`, if one exists.
136 
137 Note: this uses a naive, O(m*n) implementation for simplicity; we assume repeated partial overlap of
138 name components to be relatively uncommon, so that practical performance is closer to linear.
139 -/
140 private def findSuffixWithPrefix (base : Name) (seg : Name) : Option Name :=
141   findSuffixMatch base seg true
142 where
143   /--
144   Helper for `findSuffixWithPrefix`. If `allowOffset` is `false`, then `seg` must be a suffix of
145   `base`, not just a prefix of a suffix.
146   -/
147   findSuffixMatch : (base : Name) → (seg : Name) → (allowOffset : Bool) → Option Name
148   | _, .anonymous, _ => some .anonymous
149   | .anonymous, _, _ => none
150   | .num p n, seg@(.num p' n'), allowOffset => do
151     if n == n' then
152       if let some nm := findSuffixMatch p p' (allowOffset := false) then
153         return .num nm n
154     if allowOffset then
155       return .num (← findSuffixMatch p seg allowOffset) n
156     else
157       none
158   | .str p s, seg@(.str p' s'), allowOffset => do
159     if s == s' then
160       if let some nm := findSuffixMatch p p' (allowOffset := false) then
161         return .str nm s
162     if allowOffset then
163       return .str (← findSuffixMatch p seg allowOffset) s
164     else
165       none
166   | .str p s, seg, allowOffset =>
167     if allowOffset then
168       return .str (← findSuffixMatch p seg allowOffset) s
169     else
170       none
171   | .num p n, seg, allowOffset =>
172     if allowOffset then
173       return .num (← findSuffixMatch p seg allowOffset) n
174     else
175       none

177 private def throwNoScope : CommandElabM Unit :=
178   throwError m!"Invalid `end`: There is no current scope to end"
179     ++ .note m!"Scopes are introduced using `namespace` and `section`"
180 
181 private def throwMissingName (name : Name) : CommandElabM Unit := do
182   let hint ← liftCoreM <| MessageData.hint m!"To end the current scope `{name}`, specify its name:"
183     #[← `(end $(mkIdent name))] (codeActionPrefix? := "Add scope name: ")
184   throwError "Missing name after `end`: Expected the current scope name `{name}`{hint}"
185 
186 /--
187 Produces a hint message with a suggestion to replace the name following `end` at the current ref
188 with the name given by `scopes` if there is only one active scope; otherwise, returns `none`.
189 
190 Rationale: When there is only one active scope, only one valid `end` command is possible, so we
191 suggest it; if there are multiple, then it is harder to determine with confidence which the user
192 intended to end.
193 -/
194 private def mkSingleScopeReplacementHint? (scopes : List Scope) := do
195   -- Recall that there is always an anonymous topmost scope, so `scopes.length = 2` when there is
196   -- only one active scope:
197   if scopes.length == 2 then
198     let name := nameOfScopes scopes
199     some <$> MessageData.hint m!"Use current scope name `{name}`:" #[(← `(end $(mkIdent name)))]
200       (codeActionPrefix? := "Replace scope name: ")
201   else
202     return none
203 
204 private def throwTooManyScopeComponents (header : Name) (scopes : List Scope) : CommandElabM Unit := do
205   let hint ← liftCoreM do
206     if let some hint ← mkSingleScopeReplacementHint? scopes then
207       pure hint
208     else
209       let scopesName := nameOfScopes scopes
210       pure <| MessageData.hint' m!"The name after `end` must be `{scopesName}` or some suffix thereof"
211   throwError m!"Invalid name after `end`: `{header}` contains too many components" ++ hint
212 
213 private def throwScopeNameMismatch (header : Name) (scopes : List Scope) (endSize : Nat)
214     : CommandElabM Unit := do
215   let correspondingScopes := nameOfScopes scopes endSize
216   let allScopes := nameOfScopes scopes
217   let help ← liftCoreM do
218     if let some hint ← mkSingleScopeReplacementHint? scopes then
219       pure hint
220     else if let some suffix := findSuffixWithPrefix allScopes header then
221       let hintMsg := m!"If you meant to end the outer scope(s) `{header}`, you must end all the \
222         intervening scopes `{suffix}`:"
223       MessageData.hint hintMsg #[← `(end $(mkIdent suffix))]
224         (codeActionPrefix? := "Add intervening scopes: ")
225     else if correspondingScopes != allScopes then
226       pure <| .note m!"The current scopes are `{allScopes}`"
227     else pure .nil
228   throwError m!"Invalid name after `end`: Expected `{correspondingScopes}`, but found `{header}`" ++ help
229 
230 private def throwUnnecessaryScopeName (header : Name) : CommandElabM Unit := do
231   let hintMsg := m!"Delete the name `{header}` to end the current unnamed scope; outer named scopes \
232     can then be closed using additional `end` command(s):"
233   let hint ← liftCoreM <| MessageData.hint hintMsg #[← `(end)] (codeActionPrefix? := "Delete name: ")
234   throwError m!"Unexpected name `{header}` after `end`: The current section is unnamed" ++ hint

236 @[builtin_command_elab «end»] def elabEnd : CommandElab := fun stx => do
237   let `(end $[$header? $[.%$trailingDotTk?$_]?]?) := stx
238     | throwUnsupportedSyntax
239   let header? := header?.map (·.getId)
240   let danglingDot := trailingDotTk?.join.isSome
241   let endSize : Nat := match header? with
242     | none   => 1
243     | some n => n.getNumParts
244   let scopes ← getScopes
245   let numScopes := scopes.length
246   if numScopes == 1 then
247     throwNoScope
248   match header? with
249   | none        =>
250     addCompletionInfo <| .endSection stx none false <| scopes.map (·.header)
251     if let some name := innermostScopeName? scopes then
252       throwMissingName name
253   | some header =>
254     if endSize >= numScopes then
255       throwTooManyScopeComponents header scopes
256     else
257       addCompletionInfo <| .endSection stx header danglingDot <| scopes.map (·.header)
258       let scopesName := nameOfScopes scopes endSize
259       if scopesName != header then
260         if scopesName == .anonymous then
261           throwUnnecessaryScopeName header
262         else
263           throwScopeNameMismatch header scopes endSize
264   modify fun s => {s with scopes := s.scopes.drop endSize }
265   popScopes endSize
266 
267 private partial def elabChoiceAux (cmds : Array Syntax) (i : Nat) : CommandElabM Unit :=
268   if h : i < cmds.size then
269     catchInternalId unsupportedSyntaxExceptionId
270       (elabCommand cmds[i])
271       (fun _ => elabChoiceAux cmds (i+1))
272   else
273     throwUnsupportedSyntax

293 @[builtin_command_elab «export»] def elabExport : CommandElab := fun stx => do
294   let `(export $ns ($ids*)) := stx | throwUnsupportedSyntax
295   let nss ← resolveNamespace ns
296   let currNamespace ← getCurrNamespace
297   if nss == [currNamespace] then throwError "invalid 'export', self export"
298   let mut aliases := #[]
299   for idStx in ids do
300     let id := idStx.getId
301     let declName ← resolveNameUsingNamespaces nss idStx
302     if (← getInfoState).enabled then
303       addConstInfo idStx declName
304     aliases := aliases.push (currNamespace ++ id, declName)
305   modify fun s => { s with env := aliases.foldl (init := s.env) fun env p => addAlias env p.1 p.2 }

313 open Lean.Parser.Term

315 private def typelessBinder? : Syntax → Option (Array (TSyntax [`ident, `Lean.Parser.Term.hole]) × BinderInfo)
316   | `(bracketedBinderF|($ids*))     => some (ids, .default)
317   | `(bracketedBinderF|{$ids*})     => some (ids, .implicit)
318   | `(bracketedBinderF|⦃$ids*⦄)     => some (ids, .strictImplicit)
319   | `(bracketedBinderF|[$id:ident]) => some (#[id], .instImplicit)
320   | _                               => none
321 
322 /--  If `id` is an identifier, return true if `ids` contains `id`. -/
323 private def containsId (ids : Array (TSyntax [`ident, ``Parser.Term.hole])) (id : TSyntax [`ident, ``Parser.Term.hole]) : Bool :=
324   id.raw.isIdent && ids.any fun id' => id'.raw.getId == id.raw.getId
325 
326 /--
327   Auxiliary method for processing binder annotation update commands:
328   `variable (α)`, `variable {α}`, `variable ⦃α⦄`, and `variable [α]`.
329   The argument `binder` is the binder of the `variable` command.
330   The method returns an array containing the "residue", that is, variables that do not correspond to updates.
331   Recall that a `bracketedBinder` can be of the form `(x y)`.
332   ```
333   variable {α β : Type}
334   variable (α γ)
335   ```
336   The second `variable` command updates the binder annotation for `α`, and returns "residue" `γ`.
337 -/
338 private def replaceBinderAnnotation (binder : TSyntax ``Parser.Term.bracketedBinder) : CommandElabM (Array (TSyntax ``Parser.Term.bracketedBinder)) := do
339   let some (binderIds, binderInfo) := typelessBinder? binder | return #[binder]
340   let varDecls := (← getScope).varDecls
341   let mut varDeclsNew := #[]
342   let mut binderIds := binderIds
343   let mut binderIdsIniSize := binderIds.size
344   let mut modifiedVarDecls := false
345   -- Go through declarations in reverse to respect shadowing
346   for varDecl in varDecls.reverse do
347     let (ids, ty?, binderInfo') ← match varDecl with
348       | `(bracketedBinderF|($ids* $[: $ty?]? $(annot?)?)) =>
349         if annot?.isSome then
350           for binderId in binderIds do
351             if containsId ids binderId then
352               throwErrorAt binderId "cannot update binder annotation of variables with default values/tactics"
353         pure (ids, ty?, .default)
354       | `(bracketedBinderF|{$ids* $[: $ty?]?}) =>
355         pure (ids, ty?, .implicit)
356       | `(bracketedBinderF|⦃$ids* $[: $ty?]?⦄) =>
357         pure (ids, ty?, .strictImplicit)
358       | `(bracketedBinderF|[$id : $ty]) =>
359         pure (#[⟨id⟩], some ty, .instImplicit)
360       | _ =>
361         varDeclsNew := varDeclsNew.push varDecl; continue
362     if binderInfo == binderInfo' then
363       -- no update, ensure we don't have redundant annotations.
364       for binderId in binderIds do
365         if containsId ids binderId then
366           throwErrorAt binderId "redundant binder annotation update"
367       varDeclsNew := varDeclsNew.push varDecl
368     else if binderIds.all fun binderId => !containsId ids binderId then
369       -- `binderIds` and `ids` are disjoint
370       varDeclsNew := varDeclsNew.push varDecl
371     else
372       let mkBinder (id : TSyntax [`ident, ``Parser.Term.hole]) (binderInfo : BinderInfo) : CommandElabM (TSyntax ``Parser.Term.bracketedBinder) :=
373         match binderInfo with
374         | .default => `(bracketedBinderF| ($id $[: $ty?]?))
375         | .implicit => `(bracketedBinderF| {$id $[: $ty?]?})
376         | .strictImplicit => `(bracketedBinderF| {{$id $[: $ty?]?}})
377         | .instImplicit => do
378           let some ty := ty?
379             | throwErrorAt binder "cannot update binder annotation of variable `{id}` to instance implicit:\n\
380                 variable was originally declared without an explicit type"
381           `(bracketedBinderF| [$(⟨id⟩) : $ty])
382       for id in ids.reverse do
383         if let some idx := binderIds.findFinIdx? fun binderId => binderId.raw.isIdent && binderId.raw.getId == id.raw.getId then
384           binderIds := binderIds.eraseIdx idx
385           modifiedVarDecls := true
386           let newBinder ← mkBinder id binderInfo
387           if binderInfo.isInstImplicit then
388             -- We elaborate the new binder to make sure it's valid as instance implicit
389             try
390               runTermElabM fun _ => Term.withSynthesize <| Term.withAutoBoundImplicit <|
391                 Term.elabBinder newBinder fun _ => pure ()
392             catch e =>
393               throwErrorAt binder m!"cannot update binder annotation of variable `{id}` to instance implicit:\n\
394                 {e.toMessageData}"
395           varDeclsNew := varDeclsNew.push (← mkBinder id binderInfo)
396         else
397           varDeclsNew := varDeclsNew.push (← mkBinder id binderInfo')
398   if modifiedVarDecls then
399     modifyScope fun scope => { scope with varDecls := varDeclsNew.reverse }
400   if binderIds.size != binderIdsIniSize then
401     binderIds.mapM fun binderId =>
402       match binderInfo with
403         | .default => `(bracketedBinderF| ($binderId))
404         | .implicit => `(bracketedBinderF| {$binderId})
405         | .strictImplicit => `(bracketedBinderF| {{$binderId}})
406         | .instImplicit => throwUnsupportedSyntax
407   else
408     return #[binder]
409 
410 @[builtin_command_elab «variable»] def elabVariable : CommandElab
411   | `(variable%$tk $binders*) => do
412     let binders ← binders.flatMapM replaceBinderAnnotation
413     -- Try to elaborate `binders` for sanity checking
414     runTermElabM fun _ => Term.withSynthesize <| Term.withAutoBoundImplicit <|
415       Term.elabBinders binders fun xs => do
416         -- Determine the set of auto-implicits for this variable command and add an inlay hint
417         -- for them. We will only actually add the auto-implicits to a type when the variables
418         -- declared here are used in some other declaration, but this is nonetheless the right
419         -- place to display the inlay hint.
420         let _ ← Term.addAutoBoundImplicits xs (tk.getTailPos? (canonicalOnly := true))
421     -- Remark: if we want to produce error messages when variables shadow existing ones, here is the place to do it.
422     for binder in binders do
423       let varUIds ← (← getBracketedBinderIds binder) |>.mapM (withFreshMacroScope ∘ MonadQuotation.addMacroScope)
424       modifyScope fun scope => { scope with varDecls := scope.varDecls.push binder, varUIds := scope.varUIds ++ varUIds }
425   | _ => throwUnsupportedSyntax

427 open Meta

429 def elabCheckCore (ignoreStuckTC : Bool) : CommandElab
430   | `(#check%$tk $term) => withoutModifyingEnv <| runTermElabM fun _ => Term.withDeclName `_check do
431     -- show signature for `#check id`/`#check @id`
432     if let `($id:ident) := term then
433       try
434         for c in (← realizeGlobalConstWithInfos term) do
435           addCompletionInfo <| .id term id.getId (danglingDot := false) {} none
436           logInfoAt tk <| .signature c
437           return
438       catch _ => pure ()  -- identifier might not be a constant but constant + projection
439     let e ← Term.elabTerm term none
440     Term.synthesizeSyntheticMVarsNoPostponing (ignoreStuckTC := ignoreStuckTC)
441     -- Users might be testing out buggy elaborators. Let's typecheck before proceeding:
442     withRef tk <| Meta.check e
443     let e ← Term.levelMVarToParam (← instantiateMVars e)
444     if e.isSyntheticSorry then
445       return
446     let type ← inferType e
447     logInfoAt tk m!"{e} : {type}"
448   | _ => throwUnsupportedSyntax
449 
450 @[builtin_command_elab Lean.Parser.Command.check] def elabCheck : CommandElab := elabCheckCore (ignoreStuckTC := true)
451 
452 @[builtin_command_elab Lean.reduceCmd] def elabReduce : CommandElab
453   | `(#reduce%$tk $term) => go tk term
454   | `(#reduce%$tk (proofs := true) $term) => go tk term (skipProofs := false)
455   | `(#reduce%$tk (types := true) $term) => go tk term (skipTypes := false)
456   | `(#reduce%$tk (proofs := true) (types := true) $term) => go tk term (skipProofs := false) (skipTypes := false)
457   | _ => throwUnsupportedSyntax
458 where
459   go (tk : Syntax) (term : Syntax) (skipProofs := true) (skipTypes := true) : CommandElabM Unit :=
460     withoutModifyingEnv <| runTermElabM fun _ => Term.withDeclName `_reduce do
461       let e ← Term.elabTerm term none
462       Term.synthesizeSyntheticMVarsNoPostponing
463       -- Users might be testing out buggy elaborators. Let's typecheck before proceeding:
464       withRef tk <| Meta.check e
465       let e ← Term.levelMVarToParam (← instantiateMVars e)
466       -- TODO: add options or notation for setting the following parameters
467       withTheReader Core.Context (fun ctx => { ctx with options := ctx.options.set `smartUnfolding false }) do
468         let e ← withTransparency (mode := TransparencyMode.all) <| reduce e (skipProofs := skipProofs) (skipTypes := skipTypes)
469         logInfoAt tk e

471 def hasNoErrorMessages : CommandElabM Bool := do
472   return !(← get).messages.hasErrors
473 
474 def failIfSucceeds (x : CommandElabM Unit) : CommandElabM Unit := do
475   let resetMessages : CommandElabM MessageLog := do
476     let s ← get
477     let messages := s.messages;
478     modify fun s => { s with messages := {} };
479     pure messages
480   let restoreMessages (prevMessages : MessageLog) : CommandElabM Unit := do
481     modify fun s => { s with messages := prevMessages ++ s.messages.errorsToInfos }
482   let prevMessages ← resetMessages
483   let succeeded ← try
484     x
485     hasNoErrorMessages
486   catch
487     | ex@(Exception.error _ _) => do logException ex; pure false
488     | Exception.internal id _  => do logError (← id.getName); pure false
489   finally
490     restoreMessages prevMessages
491   if succeeded then
492     throwError "unexpected success"
493 
494 @[builtin_command_elab «check_failure»] def elabCheckFailure : CommandElab
495   | `(#check_failure $term) => do
496     failIfSucceeds <| elabCheckCore (ignoreStuckTC := false) (← `(#check $term))
497   | _ => throwUnsupportedSyntax

499 @[builtin_command_elab «synth»] def elabSynth : CommandElab := fun stx => do
500   let term := stx[1]
501   withoutModifyingEnv <| runTermElabM fun _ => Term.withDeclName `_synth_cmd do
502     let inst ← Term.elabTerm term none
503     Term.synthesizeSyntheticMVarsNoPostponing
504     let inst ← instantiateMVars inst
505     let val  ← synthInstance inst
506     logInfo val
507     pure ()

509 @[builtin_command_elab «set_option»] def elabSetOption : CommandElab := fun stx => do
510   let options ← Elab.elabSetOption stx[1] stx[3]
511   modify fun s => { s with maxRecDepth := maxRecDepth.get options }
512   modifyScope fun scope => { scope with opts := options }
513 
514 open Lean.Parser.Command.InternalSyntax in
515 @[builtin_macro Lean.Parser.Command.«in»] def expandInCmd : Macro
516   | `($cmd₁ in%$tk $cmd₂) =>
517     -- Limit ref variability for incrementality; see Note [Incremental Macros]
518     withRef tk `(section $cmd₁:command $endLocalScopeSyntax:command $cmd₂ end)
519   | _                 => Macro.throwUnsupported
520 
521 @[builtin_command_elab Parser.Command.addDocString] def elabAddDeclDoc : CommandElab := fun stx => do
522   match stx with
523   | `($doc:docComment add_decl_doc $id) =>
524     let declName ← liftCoreM <| realizeGlobalConstNoOverloadWithInfo id
525     unless ((← getEnv).getModuleIdxFor? declName).isNone do
526       throwError "invalid 'add_decl_doc', declaration is in an imported module"
527     if let .none ← findDeclarationRangesCore? declName then
528       -- this is only relevant for declarations added without a declaration range
529       -- in particular `Quot.mk` et al which are added by `init_quot`
530       addDeclarationRangesFromSyntax declName stx id
531     runTermElabM fun _ => addDocString declName (mkNullNode #[]) doc
532   | _ => throwUnsupportedSyntax
533 
534 @[builtin_command_elab Lean.Parser.Command.include] def elabInclude : CommandElab
535   | `(Lean.Parser.Command.include| include $ids*) => do
536     let sc ← getScope
537     let vars ← sc.varDecls.flatMapM getBracketedBinderIds
538     let mut uids := #[]
539     for id in ids do
540       if let some idx := vars.findIdx? (· == id.getId) then
541         uids := uids.push sc.varUIds[idx]!
542       else
543         throwError "invalid 'include', variable `{id}` has not been declared in the current scope"
544     modifyScope fun sc => { sc with
545       includedVars := sc.includedVars ++ uids.toList
546       omittedVars := sc.omittedVars.filter (!uids.contains ·) }
547   | _ => throwUnsupportedSyntax
548 
549 @[builtin_command_elab Lean.Parser.Command.omit] def elabOmit : CommandElab
550   | `(Lean.Parser.Command.omit| omit $omits*) => do
551     -- TODO: this really shouldn't have to re-elaborate section vars... they should come
552     -- pre-elaborated
553     let omittedVars ← runTermElabM fun vars => do
554       Term.synthesizeSyntheticMVarsNoPostponing
555       -- We don't want to store messages produced when elaborating `(getVarDecls s)` because they have already been saved when we elaborated the `variable`(s) command.
556       -- So, we use `Core.resetMessageLog`.
557       Core.resetMessageLog
558       -- resolve each omit to variable user name or type pattern
559       let elaboratedOmits : Array (Sum Name Expr) ← omits.mapM fun
560         | `(ident| $id:ident) => pure <| Sum.inl id.getId
561         | `(Lean.Parser.Term.instBinder| [$id : $_]) => pure <| Sum.inl id.getId
562         | `(Lean.Parser.Term.instBinder| [$ty]) =>
563           Sum.inr <$> Term.withoutErrToSorry (Term.elabTermAndSynthesize ty none)
564         | _ => throwUnsupportedSyntax
565       -- check that each omit is actually used in the end
566       let mut omitsUsed := omits.map fun _ => false
567       let mut omittedVars := #[]
568       let mut revSectionFVars : Std.HashMap FVarId Name := {}
569       for (uid, var) in (← read).sectionFVars do
570         revSectionFVars := revSectionFVars.insert var.fvarId! uid
571       for var in vars do
572         let ldecl ← var.fvarId!.getDecl
573         if let some idx := (← elaboratedOmits.findIdxM? fun
574             | .inl id => return ldecl.userName == id
575             | .inr ty => do
576               let mctx ← getMCtx
577               isDefEq ty ldecl.type <* setMCtx mctx) then
578           if let some uid := revSectionFVars[var.fvarId!]? then
579             omittedVars := omittedVars.push uid
580             omitsUsed := omitsUsed.set! idx true
581           else
582             throwError "invalid 'omit', `{ldecl.userName}` has not been declared in the current scope"
583       for o in omits, used in omitsUsed do
584         unless used do
585           throwError "`{o}` did not match any variables in the current scope"
586       return omittedVars
587     modifyScope fun sc => { sc with
588       omittedVars := sc.omittedVars ++ omittedVars.toList
589       includedVars := sc.includedVars.filter (!omittedVars.contains ·) }
590   | _ => throwUnsupportedSyntax
591 
592 @[builtin_command_elab version] def elabVersion : CommandElab := fun _ => do
593   let mut target := System.Platform.target
594   if target.isEmpty then target := "unknown"
595   -- Only one should be set, but good to know if multiple are set in error.
596   let platforms :=
597     (if System.Platform.isWindows then [" Windows"] else [])
598     ++ (if System.Platform.isOSX then [" macOS"] else [])
599     ++ (if System.Platform.isEmscripten then [" Emscripten"] else [])
600   logInfo m!"Lean {Lean.versionString}\nTarget: {target}{String.join platforms}"
601

603   logWarning "using 'exit' to interrupt Lean"

611 @[builtin_command_elab Parser.Command.where] def elabWhere : CommandElab := fun _ => do
612   let scope ← getScope
613   let mut msg : Array MessageData := #[]
614   -- Noncomputable
615   if scope.isNoncomputable then
616     msg := msg.push <| ← `(Parser.Command.section| noncomputable section)
617   -- Namespace
618   if !scope.currNamespace.isAnonymous then
619     msg := msg.push <| ← `(command| namespace $(mkIdent scope.currNamespace))
620   -- Open namespaces
621   if let some openMsg ← describeOpenDecls scope.openDecls.reverse then
622     msg := msg.push openMsg
623   -- Universe levels
624   if !scope.levelNames.isEmpty then
625     let levels := scope.levelNames.reverse.map mkIdent
626     msg := msg.push <| ← `(command| universe $levels.toArray*)
627   -- Variables
628   if !scope.varDecls.isEmpty then
629     let varDecls : Array (TSyntax `Lean.Parser.Term.bracketedBinder) := scope.varDecls.map (⟨·.raw.unsetTrailing⟩)
630     msg := msg.push <| ← `(command| variable $varDecls*)
631   -- Included variables
632   if !scope.includedVars.isEmpty then
633     msg := msg.push <| ← `(command| include $(scope.includedVars.toArray.map (mkIdent ·.eraseMacroScopes))*)
634   -- Options
635   if let some optionsMsg ← describeOptions scope.opts then
636     msg := msg.push optionsMsg
637   if msg.isEmpty then
638     logInfo m!"-- In root namespace with initial scope"
639   else
640     logInfo <| MessageData.joinSep msg.toList "\n\n"
641 where
642   /--
643   'Delaborate' open declarations.
644   Current limitations:
645   - does not check whether or not successive namespaces need `_root_`
646   - does not combine commands with `renaming` clauses into a single command
647   -/
648   describeOpenDecls (ds : List OpenDecl) : CommandElabM (Option MessageData) := do
649     let mut lines : Array MessageData := #[]
650     let mut simple : Array Name := #[]
651     let flush (lines : Array MessageData) (simple : Array Name) : CommandElabM (Array MessageData × Array Name) := do
652       if simple.isEmpty then
653         return (lines, simple)
654       else
655         return (lines.push <| ← `(command| open $(simple.map mkIdent)*), #[])
656     for d in ds do
657       match d with
658       | .explicit id decl =>
659         (lines, simple) ← flush lines simple
660         let ns := decl.getPrefix
661         let «from» := Name.mkSimple decl.getString!
662         lines := lines.push <| ← `(command| open $(mkIdent ns) renaming $(mkIdent «from») → $(mkIdent id))
663       | .simple ns ex =>
664         if ex == [] then
665           simple := simple.push ns
666         else
667           (lines, simple) ← flush lines simple
668           lines := lines.push <| ← `(command| open $(mkIdent ns) hiding $[$(ex.toArray.map mkIdent)]*)
669     (lines, _) ← flush lines simple
670     return if lines.isEmpty then none else MessageData.joinSep lines.toList "\n"
671 
672   describeOptions (opts : Options) : CommandElabM (Option MessageData) := do
673     let mut lines : Array MessageData := #[]
674     let decls ← getOptionDecls
675     for (name, val) in opts do
676       -- `#guard_msgs` sets this option internally, we don't want it to end up in its output
677       if name == `Elab.async then
678         continue
679       let (isSet, isUnknown) :=
680         match decls.find? name with
681         | some decl => (decl.defValue != val, false)
682         | none      => (true, true)
683       if isSet then
684         let cmd : TSyntax `command ←
685           match val with
686           | .ofBool true  => `(set_option $(mkIdent name) true)
687           | .ofBool false => `(set_option $(mkIdent name) false)
688           | .ofString str => `(set_option $(mkIdent name) $(Syntax.mkStrLit str))
689           | .ofNat n      => `(set_option $(mkIdent name) $(Syntax.mkNatLit n))
690           | _             => `(set_option $(mkIdent name) 0 /- unrepresentable value -/)
691         if isUnknown then
692           lines := lines.push m!"-- {cmd} -- unknown option"
693         else
694           lines := lines.push cmd
695     return if lines.isEmpty then none else MessageData.joinSep lines.toList "\n"
696

701   | _ => throwUnsupportedSyntax
